note: Parametric grain model measured from paired clean/noisy captures (SIDD Medium sRGB ground truth; no denoiser in the loop). n_c = kernel_c * (sigma_c(I_c) . w_c), w correlated across channels by `mix`; noisy = clip(I + n, 0, 1). `mix` is the Cholesky factor of the channel correlation BEFORE spatial filtering, de-attenuated by <k_c,k_d>. Entries with measured=false are interpolated across ISO from the measured ones listed in `from`.
